tables.name: Gatehouse
tables.description: The gatehouse guarding the primary passage through the wall; each result builds on the ones below it. Optional extras: a second portcullis (Strong or Grand), murder holes, spouts, other traps.

results.name: Standard Gatehouse
results.description: The same height as the wall and slightly thicker. Entry is covered by heavy doors.

results.name: Strong Gatehouse
results.description: One and a half times the height and thickness of its wall. Entry is covered by heavy doors and a portcullis.

results.name: Grand Gatehouse
results.description: Twice the height and thickness of its wall. Entry is covered by heavy doors and a portcullis.
